name: the show's icons are not kept
why: _extBbParseYear() keeps each icon's image beside its title (vzell 2026-11-12, Image #21); without it the window has nothing to draw.

edits.find: if (src) icons.push({ title: ti, src: _dpAbsUrl(src, base) });

name: the window does not draw the icons
why: _dpExtractedCols() draws data.icons in place of the Fields line.

edits.find: const icons = Array.isArray(data.icons) && data.icons.length ? data.icons : null;

name: the record carries no icons
why: _extBbDateLoad() hands the show's icons to the window record (dp.icons).

name: the year cache's version not bumped
why: A year parsed before the icons (version 1) sits in IndexedDB without them: version 2 reads it again. No spec can see it: every test starts with an empty IndexedDB and memory. A spec seeding an ext-bbyear:<year> row of version 1 would.

name: a Brucebase window opens only its readers again
why: _dpWinIsBb(): a Brucebase window opens every link with a reader in place (vzell 2026-11-12: a venue's Source: Wikipedia).

name: Brucebase's own window (on Brucebase) not counted
why: On Brucebase a venue's window is its own source, id brucebase.wikidot.com.

name: a show's window (bbdate) not counted
why: A Brucebase show on its year page is a Brucebase window too.

name: a Brucebase page's window on another site not counted
why: Elsewhere a Brucebase page opens through the springsteen reader; only brucebase.wikidot.com pages count.
